dropRules.description: Shared seal drop from eligible monsters at level 70 or above. The monster must not check Too Weak to the highest-level participant. Battlefield monsters, Dynamis and monsters with no-loot/no-experience restrictions do not qualify.
dropRules.rateNote: 20% chance for one seal/crest, then an equal choice among the types unlocked by the monster’s level. Below level 50: Beastmen’s Seal; 50–69: two types; 70–74: three types; 75+: four types. The party treasure pool has a shared five-minute seal cooldown.
